scope: Bounded SH-201-specific source audit for high-note Saw notch and antialias attribution; no DSP changes.

claims.claim: The official manual documents explicit FILTER TYPE=BYPASS. No automatic bypass at maximum CUTOFF or modulation saturation was found in pp34-36/61.
claims.confidence: high for documented controls; bounded negative for undocumented behavior

claims.claim: The deepsonic procedural recipe calls for one saw, no LFO/pitch/velocity/FX, and no thru/bypass filter configuration.
claims.confidence: high for author instructions, not proof of every captured raw parameter

claims.claim: The source instructs 50ms/500ms boundary fades and mono 44.1kHz 320kbps MP3; 96kHz/24bit is an example recommendation for the original. Actual SH-201 interface, analog-versus-USB, resampler and mono downmix are unspecified.

Pinned ALSA code identifies USB 0582:00ad as SH-201 with two standard audio interfaces and a fixed MIDI endpoint; it contains no SH-201 oscillator algorithm, coefficients or declared audio sample rate.

No identified firmware payload, primary SH-201 classic-Saw antialias implementation or published numerical notch curve was recovered in this pass. This is bounded search failure, not proof no public source exists.
